findings.message: The password reset token lifetime grows from 1 hour to 24 hours in a PR about welcome email text. A longer-lived reset token widens the window in which a leaked or intercepted token can be used to take over an account.
The new `welcome_message` function adds behaviour, but the change includes no test for it. The contributing guide requires every behaviour change to come with a test.

criteria.note: Implemented, but no test proves the subject is returned or that the body greets the user by name.

scope_creep.message: Extending the reset token lifetime to 24 hours is unrelated to the welcome email spec. It also breaks the one-change-per-PR guideline in CONTRIBUTING.md:3.
